描述_EN: by this time, the potters already mastered the use of the pink enamel, which was introduced in the decoration for porcelain, enamelled metals and glass in about 1720. in this example, the thick glossy ruby enamel, derived from pink, contrasts with the delicacy of the flowers painted with fine black lines. objects with a deep ruby-red colour were produced in the jingdezhen kilns of southern china since the reign of the yongzheng emperor (1723-35).
描述_ZN: 此时，陶工已经掌握了粉红珐琅的使用，粉红珐琅在1720年左右被引入瓷器、金属珐琅和玻璃的装饰中。 在这个例子中，源自粉红色的厚厚的光亮的红宝石珐琅，与用黑色细线画的花的精致形成了对比。 中国南方的景德镇窑场自雍正年间（1723-35）开始生产深红宝石色的物品。
